lines: Reason may favor it, but true-reason alone
is the direct means there; pure knowledge too,
impressed in many forms: offering, fire-offering,
recitation, vow, yoga. Therein all states' abode
is the Supreme Lord alone — nothing separate; for
conviction, offering all states to the Lord is
the offering — from heart-nature, offering in the
Lord is easy for those who themselves show
l4.sanskrit_cite: tarkaṃ tu anugṛhṇīyur api sattarka eva sākṣāt tatra upāyaḥ sa eva ca śuddhavidyā sa ca bahuprakāratayā saṃskṛto bhavati tadyathā yāgo homo japo vrataṃ yoga iti tatra bhāvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ parameśvara eva sthitiḥ nānyat vyatiriktam asti iti vikalparūḍhisiddhaye parameśvara eva sarvabhāvārpaṇaṃ yāgaḥ sa ca hṛdyatvāt ye saṃvidanupraveśaṃ svayam eva bhajante teṣāṃ suśakaṃ parameśvare arpaṇam ity abhiprāyeṇa hṛdyānāṃ kusumatarpaṇagandhādīnāṃ bahir upayoga uktaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is sattarka's relation to yāga etc.? → The five practices are sattarka's impress-forms; each = sarvabhāva-arpaṇa to parameśvara, externally scaffolded for heart-nature.
c1_essence: Sattarka alone direct even where tarka favors: it is śuddhavidyā impressed as yāga/homa/japa/vrata/yoga — all states' abode the Lord; external scaffolding for heart-nature.
